items.title: FLUX.2-small-decoder and gemma-4-12B-it models now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
items.blurb: Black Forest Labs' FLUX.2-small-decoder and Google's gemma-4-12B-it models are now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding the portfolio of foundation models available to AWS customers.

items.title: langcache-embed-v3-small, Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Thinking, and LightOnOCR-2-1B models now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
items.blurb: Redis's langcache-embed-v3-small, JetBrains' Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Thinking, and LightOn's LightOnOCR-2-1B models are now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding the portfolio of foundation models available to AWS customers.

items.title: GLM-5.2 FP8, NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2 and GLM-OCR models now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
items.blurb: Z.ai's GLM-5.2 FP8, NVIDIA's Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2, and Z.ai's GLM-OCR models are now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding the portfolio of foundation models available to AWS customers.

items.title: Amazon EC2 High Memory U7i instances now available in AWS South America (São Paulo) region
items.blurb: Amazon EC2 High Memory U7in-24TB instances (u7in-24tb.224xlarge) are now available in AWS South America (São Paulo) region.

items.title: Amazon GameLift Streams Now Offers Service-managed Shader Caching
items.blurb: Amazon GameLift Streams now manages shader cache capture and distribution for your applications.

items.title: Amazon EC2 introduces application status checks
items.blurb: Amazon EC2 introduces application status checks, a new status check that helps customers detect and respond to application-level issues on their EC2 instances.

items.title: Canva Shares S3 Based Architecture for Session Revocation Across Hundreds of Millions of Sessions
items.blurb: Canva redesigned session revocation infrastructure to support 100M active sessions while reducing database lookups.

items.title: How Pinterest Secures AWS Infrastructure at Scale with a Centralized Terraform Pipeline
items.blurb: Pinterest has revealed the Resource Provisioner Pipeline (RPP), its own Terraform execution engine. It ensures least-privilege access and needs dual-control reviews.

items.title: Presentation: Leveraging Adversary Emulation for GenAI Red Teaming
items.blurb: Kennedy Torkura discusses practical GenAI red teaming techniques to safeguard LLMs and knowledge bases against security threats like data poisoning and LLMjacking on AWS.

items.title: CloudFlare Previews Automatic WebMCP Support for Web Pages
items.blurb: Cloudflare announced a developer preview that lets any website enable a WebMCP (Web Model Context Protocol) interface with a single dashboard switch.
